activated.name: A WONDERFUL DREAM
activated.text: A WONDERFUL DREAM {E} — Remove up to 3 damage from chosen Princess character.

replacement.name: SHIELD ANOTHER
replacement.text: SHIELD ANOTHER Whenever one of your other characters would be dealt damage, put that many damage counters on this character instead.

static.name: VOICELESS
static.text: VOICELESS This character can't {E} to sing songs.

triggered.name: MUSICAL DEBUT
triggered.text: MUSICAL DEBUT When you play this character, look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal a song card and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.
